post.description: API to enable/disable features in NDFC. When using "Form" option to enable features, please execute GET /features to determine the current feature states. Also, note the version field returned by the GET API and increment this version field by 1 in the subsequent POST API call. Select features that you desire to enable with string "enabled" for admin_state and correspondingly "disabled" for the features to be disabled. All feature states should be filled as needed.  When using JSON Option, please execute GET /features, copy the "data" block of the returned JSON, paste this into the UI, edit "admin_state" of the features as desired, and also increment the version of the feature states.

schema.description: List of features along with their admin_state and the version of feature states need to be provided in the request body.

nxosVersion.description:

Other System images, NXOS Version generated with combination of Image name and Release version of the Image. Ex: nxos-cs.10.3.1.F.bin, NXOS Version: 10.3.1_nxos-cs.
